rows.jyutping: gaau2 dou3 A m4 on1 lok6
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something makes a person or animal feel upset, uneasy, or uncomfortable.

example.english: The sudden noise can unsettle me so much that I cannot sleep all night.
example.traditional: 突然嘅巨響搞到我唔安樂，成晚都瞓唔着。
example.jyutping: dat6 jin4 ge3 geoi6 hoeng2 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 m4 on1 lok6 sing4 maan5 dou1 fan3 m4 zoek6

rows.note: Use this when something is physically or organizationally put into disorder rather than when someone is made uneasy.

example.english: Moving house can unsettle all our original arrangements.
example.traditional: 搬屋搞亂晒我哋原本嘅安排。
example.jyutping: bun1 uk1 gaau2 lyun6 saai3 ngo5 dei6 jyun4 bun2 ge3 on1 paai4
